shots.prompt:
In the Costume Workshop late at night, moonlight cuts through high windows over silent cutting tables and still paper patterns. The Tailor's Dress Form stands as an empty linen torso on its cast-iron pedestal under the glow of a single workbench lamp.

Maren Sterling, in her charcoal knit turtleneck, dark trousers, scuffed tan work boots, and taped left index finger, carries the midnight-blue Captain's Frock Coat, its gold brocade sleeve patch gleaming. She drapes the coat onto the mannequin with reverence. Leaning in, she gently brushes a stray speck of lint from the gold brocade patch, then reaches up and turns off the bench lamp, gazing at her handiwork in the moonlit gloom.

A slow pull-back wide shot retreats from the table, lingering on Maren proudly beholding the restored coat.
